providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.description: First-party DeepSeek models; charges less outside peak hours.

executionDefinition.source:
# Routing is hand-authored; the `[[model]]` blocks below are a snapshot of the
# upstream catalog. Refresh model blocks from upstream data without replacing
# route metadata above the first `[[model]]`.

# Inference controls are endpoint contracts, separate from catalog model facts.
inference = { reasoning = "thinking_type", fast = "unavailable" }
features = { thinking = "supported", budget = { support = "unsupported", dynamic = "unsupported" }, effort = { support = "supported" }, fast = "unsupported", sources = ["https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/thinking_mode/"] }
pricing_info = { currencies = ["USD"], units = ["per_million_tokens"], dimensions = ["model", "service_tier", "submission", "input_tokens", "time"], sources = [] }

regions = ["china_mainland", "international"]
provider_id = "deepseek"
base_url = "https://api.deepseek.com"
protocol = "open_ai_chat"
connection = { group = "deepseek", connection_id = "chat", order = 0, protocol_profiles = { anthropic_messages = "deepseek-search", open_ai_responses = "deepseek-responses" } }
auth = "api_key"
credential_env = "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"
billing_mode = "per_token"

display_name = "DeepSeek"
description = "First-party DeepSeek models; charges less outside peak hours."
console_url = "https://platform.deepseek.com"
api_key_url = "https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys"
docs_url = "https://api-docs.deepseek.com"
credential_hint = "sk-"

# Thinking is on by default here, and the endpoint rejects a later turn that
# omits that turn's reasoning. With thinking on it also answers 400 to a forced
# tool choice — `required` or a named function — while `none`, `auto` and the
# tools themselves are all accepted. Incompatible forced choices are rejected.
extra = { preserve_reasoning_content = true, thinking_rejects_forced_tool_choice = true }

# This vendor charges half rate outside published peak hours, which is most of
# the week. The prices on each model below are the peak rates, because that is
# how the vendor publishes them and how the catalog records them — so a cost
# estimate that ignores this schedule is wrong by 2x for most of the week.
# https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing
#
# This table header must stay last in the route: every bare key after it would
# belong to it instead of to the route.
[pricing.peak]
utc_windows = ["01:00-04:00", "06:00-10:00"]
weekdays_only = true
off_peak_multiplier = 0.5

[[model]]
id = "deepseek-flash"
name = "DeepSeek V4.1 Flash"
description = "DeepSeek V4.1 Flash model for reasoning and agentic coding"
family = "deepseek-flash"
knowledge_cutoff = "2025-05"
release_date = "2026-09-10"
last_updated = "2026-09-10"
context_window = 1000000
# API integer ceiling verified 2026-10-14: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/create-chat-completion
max_output = 393216
input_modalities = ["text", "image"]
output_modalities = ["text"]
tool_call = true
reasoning = true
structured_output = true
temperature = true
attachment = true
open_weights = true

[model.pricing]
input_per_million = 0.3
output_per_million = 1.2
cache_read_per_million = 0.006
reasoning_per_million = 1.2
source = "models.dev"


[model.features]
thinking = "supported"
fast = "unsupported"
sources = ["https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/thinking_mode/"]
modes = ["enabled", "disabled"]
budget = { support = "unsupported", dynamic = "unsupported" }
effort = { support = "supported", levels = ["low", "high", "max"], default = "high" }

[[model]]
id = "deepseek-v4-pro"
name = "DeepSeek V4 Pro"
description = "DeepSeek V4 Pro snapshot with million-token context and support for thinking and non-thinking modes"
family = "deepseek-thinking"
release_date = "2026-08-12"
last_updated = "2026-08-22"
context_window = 1000000
# API integer ceiling verified 2026-10-14: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/create-chat-completion
max_output = 393216
input_modalities = ["text"]
output_modalities = ["text"]
tool_call = true
reasoning = true
structured_output = true
temperature = true
attachment = false
open_weights = true

[model.pricing]
input_per_million = 1.32
output_per_million = 3.96
cache_read_per_million = 0.044
reasoning_per_million = 3.96
source = "models.dev"

[model.features]
thinking = "supported"
fast = "unsupported"
sources = ["https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/thinking_mode/"]
modes = ["enabled", "disabled"]
budget = { support = "unsupported", dynamic = "unsupported" }
effort = { support = "supported", levels = ["low", "high", "max"], default = "high" }

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash model for reasoning and agentic coding
